name: 50886-structout-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine process on one GPU.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), 36 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (GQA, head_dim 128), hidden 4096, vocabulary 151936, bf16, context window 40960.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, max_requests=16, 3600 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown, static seed 50886. All 16 fire at once and none is resubmitted, so the engine sits at its max-num-seqs cap from the first decode step to the last.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, 8000 prompt tokens and 4000 output tokens, min == max, every request carrying a one-property JSON-schema structured-output constraint. temperature 0 and request_format plain, so no chat template is applied and the text is reproducible; the backend sets ignore_eos, so each request emits exactly 4000 tokens and its context grows 8000 -> 12000 over the run. Prompt content is a fresh random body per request, so the length is pinned and the text is not.
purpose: A report-drafting assistant turning long documents into schema-constrained JSON, 16 concurrent long generations on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for 50886-structout-8b-1gpu.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

reasoning-parser: kimi_k3

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 20480
max-num-seqs: 16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: false
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
